meta.name: baoyu-post-to-x
meta.description: Posts content and articles to X (Twitter). Supports regular posts with images/videos and X Articles (long-form Markdown). Uses real Chrome with CDP to bypass anti-automation. Use when user asks to "post to X", "tweet", "publish to Twitter", or "share on X".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动将内容发布到 X 平台
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要定时或批量发布推文和长文到 X。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically post content to X platform
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to schedule or batch post tweets and articles to X.

howto.what: Claude 会调用真实 Chrome 浏览器,把文字、图片、视频或 Markdown 长文发布到 X;支持普通帖、视频帖、引用转推和 X Article 长文,默认先预览,确认后才正式发布。
howto.when: 当你说「发到 X」「tweet」「publish to Twitter」等,或要求分享到 X 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这句话发到 X:今天完成了新功能
say.note: 先弹出预览,确认后才发布。

say.text: 把 article.md 发布成 X 长文章
say.note: 长文需 X Premium,发布前先预览。

say.text: 引用这条推并评论:说得对

howto.what_en: Claude will drive a real Chrome browser to post text, images, videos, or Markdown long-form articles to X. It supports regular posts, video posts, quote tweets, and X Articles, and previews before submitting.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to “post to X”, “tweet”, “publish to Twitter”, or “share on X”.

say_en.text: Post this to X: finished the new feature today.
Publish article.md as an X Article.
say_en.note: Requires X Premium; previews before publishing.

say_en.text: Quote this tweet and add: Agreed.
